workload.description: One fresh loopback relay process per source and independently installed client phase. The WAL inventory is read and SHA-256 hashed immediately before each measured start, so filesystem caches may be warm. Three native room segments include two full predecessor directories with document, comment, registration, catalog and raster-reference history, plus a fixture padding the last predecessor to its record ceiling.
workload.walBytes: Exact physical .wal bytes in the same source-native, successor and final directories before and after metered replay. The digest binds directory, filename, length and SHA-256 of each file.
workload.listeningMs: Measured from wrapper spawn to the native listening line.
workload.residentAtListeningBytes: First ps RSS observation after the listening line, before attaching any client to the measured process.
workload.maximumResidentBytes: macOS time -l kernel high-water RSS from process launch through clean exit, sampled as a separate metric.
workload.exactReplay: The metered boot leaves all retained WAL files unchanged. The following authenticated reconnect verifies document and review server clocks, the retained review cursor proof, catch-up and the exact retained client receipts and histories with submissions forbidden. The verified reader cursor may advance to its already acknowledged review batch.

scope: Two debug-build cold process observations on one macOS host, with WALs read before startup and no filesystem cache flush. No platform-independent resource budget, maximum WAL byte-size saturation, power-loss, large-raster or supported-lifetime result.
